note: A record of one real generation, kept so the feature can be shown on a host with no key. It describes what happened where it was recorded; it says nothing about the machine reading it now.

phrases.headline: Marketing agent tried to upload regulated client list to SparkMail
phrases.why: The file contains personal data for 6 people. Your policy forbids sending this level of data to external tools that retain it.
phrases.recommend: Review the audit log; no action needed.

phrases.headline: Sales agent tried to email Greenstep Tuition an offer below your floor
phrases.why: The draft quoted SGD 5,800, which is under the written minimum of SGD 6,500. A floor is a hard stop, not a suggestion.
phrases.recommend: Check the proposal and adjust pricing if needed.

phrases.headline: Finance agent tried to email Ferro Logistics figures missing from files
phrases.why: The draft stated amounts and percentages that cannot be traced to any studio document. Untraceable facts are blocked by policy.

phrases.headline: Marketing agent tried to email SparkMail the full client list
phrases.why: Sending names and contact info for 6 clients to an uncontracted vendor violates the rule against sharing regulated data externally.
phrases.recommend: Do not release; review vendor contracts.

phrases.headline: Ops agent tried to delete two unpaid invoices worth SGD 8,040
phrases.why: Deleting these files would erase proof of debt for SGD 8,040. Deletions of financial records always require your approval.
phrases.recommend: Approve or reject in the queue.

phrases.headline: Support agent drafted email to QuickPrint confirming SGD 720 spend and reading private files.
phrases.why: The draft commits unconfirmed money. It also accessed regulated owner records like NRIC and home address, which were not needed for this task.
phrases.recommend: Review the draft and confirm if you approve the SGD 720 cost.

phrases.headline: Ops agent tried to pay Jia Wen SGD 1,200 without a matching invoice on file.
phrases.why: This payment exceeds the SGD 1,000 limit and lacks an invoice. The system held it because no document supports this specific amount.
phrases.recommend: Check if an invoice exists or reject this payment request.

phrases.headline: Marketing agent drafted email to editor@designweek.example who is not in client or supplier lists.
phrases.why: The recipient is unknown to the studio. Sending case studies to unverified contacts risks sharing internal information with parties outside our agreements.
phrases.recommend: Verify this contact's legitimacy before releasing the email.

phrases.headline: Support agent opened 5 files including 3 regulated ones when only 1 was needed.
phrases.why: The agent accessed private financial notes and owner records unnecessarily. While nothing was sent, reading these files violates data scope rules.
phrases.recommend: Monitor future tasks to ensure agents stick to required files.

phrases.headline: Marketing agent opened regulated client list file for a task that did not need it.
phrases.why: The job did not require accessing personal client data like phone numbers. This read occurred outside the permitted scope for this specific task.
phrases.recommend: Remind agents to check task requirements before opening sensitive files.
